name: Seedance 2.5
tagline: Controllable AI video generation up to 30 seconds in a single pass at up to 1080p.
description:
Seedance 2.5 creates controllable AI videos up to 30 seconds long in a single pass. It turns text, images, video and audio into finished clips, so you no longer need to stitch many short generations together by hand. Output renders in up to 1080p, ready for social platforms, ads and presentations.

Key Features:
- Text-to-video and image-to-video modes
- Up to 50 multimodal references for character, motion and style consistency
- Single-pass clips up to 30 seconds
- Up to 1080p output
- Flexible editing to refine a result instead of starting over
- Suited for marketing demos, anime-style scenes, short-form social content and cinematic concepts
